TRUTHS will help deliver improved confidence in Earth Observation (EO) data gathered from space and the forecasts driven by this data.
This mission will enable the upgrade of the performance of the EO system, both in space and on the ground. The mission will facilitate the development of a global, climate observatory, delivering data of unprecedented accuracy with SI traceability - establishing a 'standards laboratory in space'.

TRUTHS was authorised at ESA CMin22 for a Phase B2/Advance C, whereas the continuation of the mission through Phase C/D-E1 is subject to further approval at ESA CMin25.
In this framework, Airbus Defence and Space Ltd will release an Invitation To Tender for the procurement of the PMCS HW and SW for the TRUTHS Phase Advance C (1 year), with a mandatory option for Phase C/D. 

Procurement of PMCS will be split into two parts:
1. PMCS HW, which includes the models, the Boot Loader Software (BSW) and the hardware dependant software (HDSW))
2. PMCS Application Software (ASW)
The tenderer can decide to submit an offer for any of the two parts (HW or ASW) as well as for both (HW + ASW).

The Invitation To Tender will be addressed to all ESA Member States, since the geographical return of the mission is subject to change at ESA CMin25.
